datasets.title: Accelerometer-Based Multivariate Time-Series Dataset for Calf Behavior Classification
datasets.redistribution: Permitted with attribution, license link, and indication of changes.
datasets.population: 30 pre-weaned Holstein Friesian and Jersey calves in Ireland
datasets.labels: 23 behavior classes in the source ethogram; originals are preserved and canonical labels remain UNKNOWN.
datasets.continuity: UNKNOWN; the paper notes collection interruptions for recharging.
limitations: The CSV unit and timestamp timezone are not documented by the publisher; values are not converted.
The source description and actual CSV header differ in capitalization; the adapter requires the actual header.
segId is a behavior segment identifier, not a verified collection session identifier.
Neck-mounted sensor observations do not validate ear-tag performance.

datasets.title: Precision Beef - Animal Behaviour Classification
datasets.download_reason: No Precision Beef acquisition adapter is implemented in this MVP.
datasets.redistribution: Permitted with attribution, license link, and indication of changes.
datasets.population: 18 cattle across three farm trials; breeds are not stated in the inspected primary metadata.
datasets.sensor: Afimilk Silent Herdsman collar accelerometer; Rumiwatch halter supplies behavior predictions.
datasets.labels: Device predictions: 0 Other, 1 Ruminating, 2 Eating or Drinking. Class 2 remains UNKNOWN canonically.
datasets.continuity: UNKNOWN; official readme gives recording spans, but uninterrupted sampling is not established.
limitations: Labels are predictions by a separate device, not manually observed ground truth.
Drinking is deliberately merged with eating in label 2.
Accelerometer and label timestamps do not exactly coincide; any alignment policy must be explicit.
The collar is not an ear-tag.
